text: The nightly backup runs at 03:10 UTC and keeps three copies of the database.
Backups now keep seven copies of the database; three was not enough after the disk failure.
The deploy script refuses any branch but dev and rolls back when the health check fails.
Port 8900 is the default for the local server; production listens on 8893 behind the proxy.
The disk on the build machine is 82% full; the Rust target directory alone is 40 GB.
Cleared the old build caches: the build machine disk is back to 51% full.
The certificate for the public door expires on 12 March; renewal is automatic through the ACME client.
The rate limit for public writes is 30 per minute per seat.
The rate limit for public writes was raised to 60 per minute per seat after the import job hit it.
Monitoring pages the on-call seat when p95 search latency stays above 3 seconds for ten minutes.
The retention sweep removes feed records older than 48 hours; other rooms keep everything.
Tokens are written to files with mode 0600 and are never printed.
Corners are 4 px on surfaces and 3 px on controls; no pill shapes anywhere.
One accent colour, green, and it only means live or current.
The phone layout keeps the primary action in the bottom bar, within thumb reach.
Icon-only buttons need a label that shows on hover, keyboard focus and touch.
The chat view puts the newest message next to the input box, like a messaging app.
The type scale is 1.20 from 17 px, and nothing is set below 13 px.
Dark mode shows depth with luminance steps instead of borders.
Labels on the map were hidden because they covered the route line; buttons there keep their icons.
Hybrid recall fuses BM25 word search and embedding search with reciprocal rank fusion.
On the twenty real moments, the reranker moved first-place answers from 13 to 18.
LongMemEval session hit@5 was 0.966 on the cleaned dataset: retrieval only, no reader model.
The cross-encoder reranker adds about four seconds per query on a CPU.
PageRank over citations gave no gain when fused and made results worse when multiplied.
Competitor survey: most memory systems need a language model to extract facts, which is slow on a CPU.
The embedding model is snowflake arctic embed, run locally on the CPU.
Approved records should be a boost, not a tier that buries today's facts.
Abstention questions have no answer session and are left out of hit@5.
Today: finishing the installer edge cases; blocked on nothing.
Yesterday the import of the old archive stalled at 40%; rerunning it tonight.
The old archive import finished: 8,299 records, every signature verified.

The planning meeting is back on Wednesday at 10:00.

Production releases are open again; the holiday freeze is over.

Reviewing pull requests for the server and the search module.
